apps.googleCalendarHowUpdate: An sabunta ajiya → an sabunta wannan abu ɗaya
apps.googleCalendarHowCancel: An soke ajiya → an soke ko cire abu
apps.paystackOverview: Paystack lets guests pay online into your hotel's own Paystack account for direct bookings and invoices. Sena records the payment against the stay or invoice after Paystack confirms it.
apps.paystackBenefit1: Collect card payments into your own Paystack account
apps.paystackBenefit2: Use the same connection for booking and invoice checkouts
apps.paystackBenefit3: Keep verified payments reflected on the folio
apps.paystackPrereq2: Your live or test secret key from the Paystack dashboard
apps.paystackStep3: Save and confirm the connection tests successfully
apps.paystackGoodToKnow: Sena stores your key encrypted and routes payment attempts for this property only. Disconnecting removes the key from Sena; past payments in Sena stay recorded.
apps.paystackHowCreate: Guest pays → Paystack confirms → Sena records the payment
apps.paystackHowUpdate: Webhook or verification refresh → folio payment status updates
apps.flutterwaveOverview: Flutterwave lets guests pay online into your hotel's own Flutterwave account. Sena records successful payments against bookings and invoices for this property.
apps.flutterwaveBenefit1: Collect online payments into your Flutterwave account
apps.flutterwaveBenefit2: Support booking and invoice payment surfaces
apps.flutterwaveBenefit3: Keep verified payments on the Sena folio
apps.flutterwavePrereq2: Your secret key from the Flutterwave dashboard
apps.flutterwaveStep3: Save and confirm the connection tests successfully
apps.flutterwaveGoodToKnow: Only this property uses the connected key. Sena remains the source of truth for folio balances after settlement.
apps.flutterwaveHowCreate: Guest pays → Flutterwave confirms → Sena records the payment
apps.flutterwaveHowUpdate: Verification refresh → folio payment status updates
apps.zohoInvoiceOverview: Zoho Invoice receives guests, invoices, and verified payments that Sena exports. Accounting stays in Zoho while Sena remains the source of truth for what was settled at the hotel.
apps.zohoInvoiceBenefit1: Export invoices without retyping guest details
apps.zohoInvoiceBenefit2: Keep verified payments reflected in Zoho
apps.zohoInvoiceBenefit3: Choose which Zoho organization receives exports
apps.zohoInvoicePrereq2: Permission to authorize Sena for that organization
apps.zohoInvoicePrereq3: An organization ready to receive exported invoices
apps.zohoInvoiceStep2: Sign in to Zoho and approve access
apps.zohoInvoiceGoodToKnow: Sena does not replace Zoho as your accounting system. Editing records in Zoho does not change stays or balances inside Sena.
apps.zohoInvoiceHowCreate: New invoice → exported to Zoho Invoice
apps.zohoInvoiceHowUpdate: Verified payment → payment sync to Zoho when enabled
apps.whatsappOverview: WhatsApp Business is intended for guest lifecycle messages through the official WhatsApp Business Platform. Availability follows the WhatsApp connection status in Connected Apps.
apps.whatsappBenefit1: Reach guests on a channel they already use
apps.whatsappBenefit2: Send operational stay messages from Sena workflows
apps.whatsappBenefit3: Keep messaging tied to the same property account
apps.whatsappPrereq2: Permission to connect that account to Sena
apps.whatsappStep3: Return to Sena to finish setup
apps.whatsappGoodToKnow: Message delivery depends on WhatsApp Business Platform policies and template approval where required.
apps.whatsappHowCreate: Lifecycle event → message queued to WhatsApp
apps.whatsappHowUpdate: Delivery status → reflected in message history when available
apps.stripeOverview: Stripe is planned so hotels can accept card payments through Stripe. Connect is not available yet.
apps.outlookCalendarOverview: Outlook Calendar is planned so Sena reservations can appear in Microsoft Outlook calendars. Connect is not available yet.
apps.gmailOverview: Gmail is planned for sending guest email from a connected Gmail account. Connect is not available yet.
apps.outlookMailOverview: Outlook Mail is planned for sending guest email from Outlook. Connect is not available yet.
apps.brevoOverview: Brevo is planned for transactional guest email delivery. Connect is not available yet.
apps.zohoBooksOverview: Zoho Books is planned for accounting sync beyond Zoho Invoice. Connect is not available yet.
apps.zohoBooksBenefit2: Keep Sena as operational source of truth (planned)
apps.quickbooksOverview: QuickBooks Online is planned for accounting sync. Connect is not available yet.
apps.xeroOverview: Xero is planned for accounting sync. Connect is not available yet.
apps.channexOverview: Channex is planned to help distribute inventory across OTAs. Connect is not available yet.
apps.bookingComOverview: Booking.com is planned as a channel connection. Connect is not available yet.
apps.airbnbOverview: Airbnb is planned as a channel connection. Connect is not available yet.
apps.expediaOverview: Expedia is planned as a channel connection. Connect is not available yet.
